title: PYSEC-2025-19
summary: Affected: PyPI: picklescan picklescan before 0.0.22 only considers standard pickle file extensions in the scope for its vulnerability scan. An attacker could craft a malicious model that uses Pickle and include a malicious pickle file with a non-standard file extension. Because the malicious pickle file inclusion is not considered as part of the scope of picklescan, the file would pass security checks and appear to be safe, when it could instead prove to be problematic.

title: PYSEC-2024-115
summary: Affected: PyPI: langchain-community A vulnerability in the GraphCypherQAChain class of langchain-ai/langchain-community version 0.2.5 allows for SQL injection through prompt injection. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized data manipulation, data exfiltration, denial of service (DoS) by deleting all data, breaches in multi-tenant security environments, and data integrity issues. Attackers can create, update, or delete nodes and relationships without proper authorization, extract sensitive data, disrupt services, access data across different tenants, and compromise the integrity of the database.

title: CVE-2026-115932 — Path traversal in post media lets any registered user read server files
summary: Affected: GitroomHQ postiz-app When a post is published, Postiz treats a media path that is not a web address as a file on the server's disk, but it does not check that the file lies inside the upload directory. A registered user can store a crafted media path with a post, get it past the checks that normally restrict it, and have the publishing worker read an arbitrary file and send it as an attachment to a Discord server the user controls. The same unconfined reads can be reached through two further routes. One tells the caller whether a file exists and can exhaust the backend's memory, the other delivers the file the same way as the main route. Self-registration is open by default, so the attacker needs no existing account.

title: CVE-2026-9765 — CVE-2026-9765 CVE Record
summary:
Affected: Grafana IRM Note: The CVE and blog post don't exist because we determined this is actually a cloud-only issue. Access Controls are “Broken” when a user can access resources they are not authorized to access. An attacker can bypass any access control mechanisms in a web application, and gain unauthorized access to resources that are not available with their permissions. Broken access control can allow attackers to:
Access resources only accessible to certain users, thus allowing unauthorized access to data
Perform operations on behalf of other users, leading to account takeovers in the worst cases
Attempt privilege escalation
Attempt to take over an account

title: CVE-2026-9737 — Find command with $meta sort can lead to crash
summary: Affected: MongoDB Server During query planning when reading the sort pattern in raw BSONObj form, in some places we don’t explicitly handle the meta expression case. This may lead to incorrect transformations leading to invariant failure.

title: CVE-2026-9680 — MCP Server Exposure via Insecure Default Binding on alibabacloud-rds-openapi-mcp-server
summary: Affected: Alibaba Cloud RDS OpenAPI MCP Server Improper exposure of the MCP server in alibabacloud-rds-openapi-mcp-server allows remote attackers to invoke exposed MCP tools via network access to an MCP endpoint listening on all network interfaces by default.

title: CVE-2026-9318 — tablib versions prior to 3.10.0 Stored XSS via HTML Export Dataset Title
summary: Affected: Jazzband tablib tablib prior to 3.10.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the HTML export functionality that allows attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript by embedding malicious payloads in dataset titles, which are interpolated unsanitized into HTML output via the export_book method in the _html.py format handler. Attackers can rename worksheet sheets in imported files such as XLSX, ODS, XLS, or YAML with script payloads that are assigned to the Dataset title attribute and rendered unescaped inside an HTML h3 tag, leading to session hijacking, unauthorized administrative actions, and sensitive data exposure when the output is rendered in a browser.

title: CVE-2026-9214 — Insufficient input validation in NETGEAR R7000 router allows administrators to tamper with the device.
summary:
Affected: NETGEAR R7000 Insufficient input validation vulnerability in the NETGEAR R7000 models
 allows authenticated administrators connected to the local network to 
make unauthorized modification to router software and functionality.

title: CVE-2026-9205 — Langflow is affected by weaknesses in secret handling and sensitive configuration access
summary: Affected: IBM Langflow OSS IBM Langflow OSS contains a weak cryptographic key derivation vulnerability in the ensure_fernet_key() function.

title: CVE-2026-9203 — Server-side request forgery in Progress MarkLogic Server
summary: Affected: Progress Software Corporation MarkLogic Server A server-side request forgery vulnerability in Progress MarkLogic Server before 11.3.6 and 12.0.3 allows an authenticated user with low-privileged roles to bypass protections for cloud instance metadata endpoints. Successful exploitation can disclose cloud credentials and compromise cloud resources accessible to the host instance.
